Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 15
Reason for Mistake: When instructed to find the Hokkaido Nippon-Ham Fighters 2023 roster, WebSurfer opened and relied on an “Active Players” page explicitly marked “UPDATE: At the end of 2024 season,” not the July 2023 roster. This temporal mismatch led to using 2024 neighbors around #19 (yielding Yamasaki, Sugiyura) instead of the correct July 2023 neighbors (Yoshida, Uehara). The incorrect source selection directly propagated to the wrong final answer.
